answer: Each identity files one fable, a work claim, in the opal registry and posts a 70-credit bond. A comet sweep each epoch cross-checks each fable against evidence and fingerprint; a mismatch burns the bond and bars the identity. Fresh evidence costs 20 credits, so the k-th fake still pays 90, with no reuse, and 1,000 fakes cost 90,000. A shared source triggers a deeper sweep adding 30 per fake, raising 1,000 fakes to 120,000. A rented fingerprint farm fails, since one reused fingerprint burns both bonds. An honest agent files one fable, pays 20 once, and recovers its bond.
